scope.input: synthetic explicit dotted-path projection flattened after MessageToDict at Google Ads resource grain
scope.output: current Decision Intelligence Lab observation contract

raw_row_envelope.one_batch_scope: one customer.id, one campaign.id, one campaign resource, one customer.currency_code, one janela and one lido_em
raw_row_envelope.clock: explicit timezone-aware agora argument; no process clock
raw_row_envelope.capture_encoding: explicit flattened projection produced after MessageToDict(preserving_proto_field_name=True, always_print_fields_with_no_presence=False): identity int64 is a canonical decimal string in 1..2^63-1, metric int64 is a decimal string in 0..2^63-1, int32 is a JSON integer, double is a JSON number, bool is boolean, enum is its name string

projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.input: source_fields is the explicit dotted-path projection flattened by an adapter after MessageToDict for one GoogleAdsRow; a nested dict is not accepted by this boundary
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.output: the same closed source_fields projection constrained by the grain mapping; the normalizer does not recursively flatten or materialize omitted scalars
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.selection_evidence: coverage_receipt.grains.<grain>.selected_fields records the exact GAQL fields selected; selection is not proof that a scalar was measured or materially present
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.omitted_no_presence_defaults: zero-fill is forbidden: no omitted int64, int32, double or bool becomes zero or false inside the normalizer
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.not_selected: remains absent; a required field rejects the batch and nullable Quality Info remains absent while blocking decision eligibility
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.explicit_null: every required scalar rejects null; Quality Score/components null are treated as absent and never receive an invented value
projection_between_message_to_dict_and_b.live_presence_limit: the synthetic fixture does not prove live protobuf presence semantics or that a production adapter distinguished omission from an observed zero

coverage_receipt.customer_time_zone: observed IANA account timezone; calendar_timezone must match it byte-for-byte
coverage_receipt.query_window: required exact inicio/fim object; it must equal every raw row janela and is the authority for exact campaign_day date coverage
coverage_receipt.adapter_conversions: closed field-to-conversion map; only ad_group_criterion.quality_info.quality_score mapped to int32_to_canonical_decimal_string permits a canonical decimal string instead of the native int32 JSON integer
coverage_receipt.selected_fields: required on every grain, including zero-row vazio_confirmado; it proves GAQL selection, never measurement or scalar presence

mappings.rule: metrics.conversions_value is a required protobuf double JSON number converted with Decimal(str(source)) * 1000000 and must yield exact integer micros; binary-double noise beyond an exact micro is rejected fail-closed. Int64 metrics arrive as decimal strings in 0..2^63-1 and become canonical integers. Explicit zero is accepted, while omission or null rejects. campaign_day completo must cover every inclusive coverage_receipt.query_window date exactly once
required share and lost-share ratios are the campaign-window observation and are never reconstructed by averaging campaign_day rows; explicit zero is accepted while omission or null rejects

Quality Score and each component preserve absent/null by omitting the normalized key. Present Quality Score is a native int32 JSON integer 1..10; a canonical decimal string is accepted only when coverage_receipt.adapter_conversions explicitly declares int32_to_canonical_decimal_string. Present components must be ABOVE_AVERAGE, AVERAGE or BELOW_AVERAGE. Any absent quality field, including a wholly empty quality collection, makes decision_eligible false. negative must be explicitly present false; type=KEYWORD, status and system_serving_status remain mandatory observed evidence

SearchTermMatchType is preserved as its own proto enum token and is not mapped through KeywordMatchType; search_term_view.status is also preserved. UNKNOWN/UNSPECIFIED rejects. The resource suffix convention used here is URL-safe base64 without padding over the exact UTF-8 search_term; this premise is covered synthetically with a padding-requiring term but remains unverified against a live GoogleAdsRow. VOLC business annotations remain outside this normalizer

type must be KEYWORD and campaign_criterion.negative must be explicitly present true; omission or null rejects before the polarity gate. match_type is a compatibility alias carrying the same KeywordMatchType value

type must be KEYWORD and ad_group_criterion.negative must be explicitly present true; omission or null rejects before the polarity gate. status/system_serving_status must be observed rather than UNKNOWN/UNSPECIFIED; match_type is a compatibility alias carrying KeywordMatchType

lineage_on_every_normalized_row.lido_em: same normalized UTC instant for the batch
lineage_on_every_normalized_row.as_of_date: explicit closed calendar date for the batch
lineage_on_every_normalized_row.calendar_timezone: observed account IANA calendar copied from the matching coverage receipt and used for as-of/read comparisons

fields.source_field: exact Google Ads source field name

lineage_on_every_normalized_row.absent_optional_field: has no target key and no fields mapping entry

temporal_authority.normalizer: the account calendar observed as coverage_receipt.customer_time_zone is authoritative for deciding which account day is closed; calendar_timezone must match exactly
temporal_authority.normalized_instant: lido_em is emitted in UTC after closure was evaluated in the observed IANA calendar
temporal_authority.kernel: the existing kernel uses the timezone carried by its explicit agora argument for replay as-of and future-read checks; its window-closure comparison uses lido_em.date() in lido_em's normalized offset, naive datetimes fall back to UTC in _dt, and every ambiguity remains fail-closed; this second gate does not replace or reinterpret the account calendar

batch_output.eligibility: normalization succeeds only when every grain is completo or zero-row vazio_confirmado, every receipt declares selected_fields, required grains are completo, every row window equals coverage_receipt.query_window, campaign_day covers every inclusive query_window date exactly once, required scalars are materially present/non-null and enums are observed; absent Quality Info or a wholly empty quality collection marks source partial and makes decision_eligible=false
batch_output.fingerprint: SHA-256 of the canonical normalized Google contract, including query_window, adapter_conversions, selected_fields per grain, customer_time_zone, coverage, as_of_date and calendar_timezone
batch_output.external_revenue: absent by contract; caller attaches external revenue after Google normalization

closed_gates: require customer_time_zone, query_window and adapter_conversions globally and selected_fields on every per-grain receipt, including vazio_confirmado
reject unknown or mixed raw grain and every extra, non-selected or required missing source field
reject mixed customer_id, campaign_id, resource_name, janela or lido_em; every row janela must exactly equal coverage_receipt.query_window
reject dates outside coverage_receipt.query_window, any future janela, segments.date or lido_em, and campaign_day completo without exactly one row for every inclusive query_window date
reject duplicate natural keys within every raw grain

reject omitted, zero, leading-zero, signed, overflow or otherwise non-canonical identity decimal strings in 1..2^63-1 before resource_name or duplicate comparisons; then reject resource names inconsistent with IDs
reject a search_term_view resource suffix that is not the URL-safe base64 encoding without padding of exact search_term UTF-8; this convention remains a non-live premise
reject mixed or malformed customer.currency_code
forbid zero-fill: selected_fields proves selection only; every omitted/null required scalar rejects and nullable Quality Info remains absent
reject MessageToDict scalar shape mismatches: int64 must be a canonical decimal string in 0..2^63-1 without leading zero, double JSON number, bool boolean and enum token string
reject negative or null required metrics, booleans as numbers, invalid int64 strings and int64 overflow

preserve absent/null Quality Score/components as omitted normalized keys; accept native int32 JSON integer 1..10 and accept a canonical decimal string only with the adapter conversion declared in the receipt; reject present unknown components; any omission or wholly empty quality collection blocks decision eligibility
require type=KEYWORD and negative=true for campaign/ad-group negatives; require negative=false for positive keyword quality rows
reject contradictory criterion/resource reuse across positive and negative grains

validate KeywordMatchType only against the supported EXACT/PHRASE/BROAD subset; preserve SearchTermMatchType separately without claiming its entire Google domain; reject UNKNOWN/UNSPECIFIED in status, serving status and search-term match type families
reject share percentages outside [0,1]
preserve campaign/criterion status and applicable serving status; absence or unknown sentinel rejects the exact grain contract

require calendar_timezone to match the observed account customer_time_zone exactly, require as_of_date before lido_em in that IANA calendar and reject a window after as-of or not closed before the read

retain the kernel's independent temporal gate: explicit agora timezone for replay as-of and future-read checks, lido_em.date() in its normalized offset for window closure, UTC fallback for naive datetimes in _dt, all fail-closed
canonicalize integral doubles, decimals and signed zero before fingerprint so 5 equals 5.0 and -0.0 equals 0.0
sort daily_metrics chronologically
preserve nullable absence separately from selected-and-measured explicit zero
reject monetary protobuf-double noise fail-closed when Decimal(str(source)) cannot produce exact integer currency micros
not_proven_here: Google Ads collection or a production GoogleAdsRow adapter
authenticity of a production coverage receipt
live MessageToDict capture exercised by this synthetic fixture
real protobuf scalar presence or an adapter that proves omission versus observed zero
the URL-safe base64 without-padding search_term_view suffix convention against a live GoogleAdsRow
